description: "Use when an agent needs an execution-ready implementation plan with explicit phases, evidence, and exit criteria."
applyTo: ".ai/tasks/**/*.md"
---

# Execution Planning

- Start with a short execution map before implementation.
- Split non-trivial work into explicit phases.
- Each phase should state:
  - objective
  - actions
  - evidence artifacts
  - exit criteria
- Keep plans execution-ready, not aspirational.
- Update plans with deltas only.
